intro: Technology, government, and healthcare sectors bore the brunt of a concentrated wave of attacks in a 23-day period ending May 4, 2026, with 53 articles cataloging 24 high-severity and 7 critical incidents. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed, while the most critical vulnerabilities exploited were CVE-2026-5760, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8, and CVE-2026-5752, with a score of 9.3. The activity spanned global targets, with significant impacts across China, North America, and the United States, affecting cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and other sectors.
